references.text: David was also lowered through a window by his wife Michal to escape danger, a parallel to Rahab's action with the spies.
Paul was lowered in a basket through an opening in the wall at Damascus, a similar escape method that Rahab used to help the spies.
Paul mentions that he was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall, a direct parallel to Rahab's action.
The scarlet cord that was to be hung in the window is linked to the same window from which Rahab let the spies down.
The fulfillment of the promise given to Rahab, where she and her family were saved because of her help in hiding the spies.
Rahab is mentioned as an example of faith because she welcomed the spies and helped them escape.
